title: Proper flat perfect direct image in independently supplied derived models
statement: Let f:X→Y be a proper, flat, locally finitely presented morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Supply derived categories of module sheaves on X and Y with possibly different Hom universes, and derived categories on their respective localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. For every perfect object E of D(O_X) [def-pc-perfect-complex], the shared derived direct image Rf_*E [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is perfect on Y. Neither quasi-compactness of Y nor a right adjoint is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 36.30.4(1), Tag 0B91 (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B91), its proof using Lemma 36.30.1, Tag 0A1H

proof.text: Use the universal property of derived localization to compare the supplied derived categories, including those on opens, with standard K-injective models in a common sufficiently large Hom universe. Exact restriction commutes with the localization equivalences, so local strictly perfect representatives are preserved and reflected. Derived direct image commutes with these equivalences by its K-injective construction. The statement concerns an already supplied object E; no arbitrary object is chosen from an unproved existence assertion.

In the common models apply lem-pc-proper-support-perfect-direct-image with the given perfect object E and G=O_X concentrated in degree zero. G is bounded. Its terms are finitely presented; the nonzero term is flat over Y because f is flat and has proper support because f is proper. Zero terms are finitely presented and flat and have empty proper support. Properness supplies quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of f, and local finite presentation combined with quasi-compactness is finite presentation. The tensor-unit isomorphism E tensor^L O_X ≅ E identifies the first conclusion with perfectness of Rf_*E.

Transport the conclusion back to the supplied model on Y, using the compatible equivalences on its opens. Each local strictly perfect representative of Rf_*E remains a representative there. Thus the conclusion holds with the original independent Hom universes. The argument also covers the empty scheme and E=0.

lean.statement:
theorem properFlat_derivedDirectImage_perfect
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : Scheme.IsPerfect X E) :
    Scheme.IsPerfect Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)
